facts.title: Pecan Granola Bars
ingredients: 2 cups quick-cooking oats (or old-fashioned oats, pulsed briefly in a food processor or blender to break them up)
½ teaspoon fine sea salt (if using regular table salt or salted nut butter, scale back a bit)
1 cup homemade pecan butter* or creamy almond butter or peanut butter
½ cup maple syrup or honey
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
